decision: RETAIN_CONTRACT_WITH_SEQUENCE_CORRECTIONS; application adoption and false-parity removal remain HOLD
method: Read-only immutable git-show/diff review. No product edits, application executions, Rust tests, pushes, reference decisions, or helper agents in this follow-up.

tree_correction.P3: CLOSED: audit explicitly distinguishes development starting point48c5fc33, publication base25d2a361, and reviewed source12e011659 parent.
tree_correction.scope_warning: The aggregate12e→92 comparison also includes unrelated Jackin editor_view.rs changes and migration matrix edits. Those incoming changes are not approved by this review.

findings.issue: Group exposes measure/show and private slots, but does not implement CompositionLeaf. MasterDetail has state-dependent measure/show using ui.full(), not a public borrowed leaf. AppShell accepts CompositionLeaf. The packet names all blocks but does not yet provide a compiled, geometry-free path connecting them.
findings.action: First add borrowed adapters/interop in the existing facade/block families that delegate their existing shared renderer within the resolver-owned area. Do not make the application implement CompositionLeaf, call ui.with_area with its own geometry, or create a second layout engine. Prove nested shell→master/detail→group measurement/draw/input bounds using an external consumer.

findings.issue: The proposed early app tree-owner migration cannot leave the current Manager painter and flat-list update path live without either breaking them or mirroring ListState/TreeState and selected_row. Existing render selectors and commands read manager.list. Partial hidden adoption would add another owner and would not prove the visible component.
findings.action: Prepare shared APIs and semantic application view-data first without shadow runtime state. Switch Manager update, draw, state and selector removal in the same final adoption increment. Never keep a second mutable cursor/expansion/drawer value to satisfy the old painter.

findings.issue: ItemRow currently unconditionally emits a gutter and available tag/detail; Tree already owns its row chrome. It does not express the frozen metadata threshold44, middle truncation, trailing reservation and exact metadata gap. A whole historical row callback or app remaining-width arithmetic would bypass component ownership.
findings.action: Prove the missing policies through public component tests, then extend the existing semantic row family with explicit general layout/truncation/metadata visibility policy. Tree must retain sole gutter/disclosure/hit/selection/scroll ownership. Demonstrate a second consumer; no Manager-named variant.

findings.issue: The current private Manager painter is720 lines, not the previous646. Detail drawer and help underlay now call paint_pinned_split. Deleting only the initial Manager caller leaves production bypasses.
findings.action: Use call-site inventory at the adoption commit. Remove the whole module/exports and every caller after real underlay composition is available; retain help overlay mechanics in Overlays. Audit manager_frame and session_chrome separately rather than claim their removal through this one module.

application_domain: World, clock and account/workspace/instance eligibility stay outside Termrock.
ManagerRowKey and reversible stable ItemKey mapping identify current-directory/workspace/instance/new-workspace nodes.
Build a full semantic hierarchy in frozen order; do not preflatten only expanded rows. Current source places workspaces before current-directory and omits NewWorkspace, unlike frozen contract.
Domain actions map typed Tree/Button/Menu actions to launch, route, inspect and world mutations.
single_state_owners: TreeState solely owns cursor, chosen value where needed, expansion and tree scroll. Remove ManagerState.list and expanded Vec; selected domain identity is derived from the stable-key mapping.
MasterDetailState solely owns drawer and master split. Remove detail_open bool; no shadow state.
PropsState or an existing shared scrollable detail component owns detail selection/scroll; application stores its public state, not key navigation mechanics.
Button owns hit/press/keyboard action; shared scope/container owns horizontal focus routing.
Existing runtime owns focus, pointer capture, layer scope and caret. Preserve actual visible control ownership; do not register an invisible DETAIL control.
library_files: Facade composition/block adapters and tests: one writer.
Navigation tree/item semantic row contract and tests: one separate writer only after shared API agreement; do not overlap ongoing Tabs/NavList writer files.
Controls detail/action alignment or focusable panel/content APIs only if a concrete frozen-contract probe proves current API insufficient.
Jackin app.rs and host-ui Manager state: one serialized adoption writer after prerequisites; no parallel overlapping app writer.

bounded_sequence.atomic_increment: Existing-block interoperability only. Add a borrowed Group leaf and stateful MasterDetail adapter (or equivalent direct shared API interoperability) needed by actual shell consumers; keep AppShell, resolver and existing renderers as sole implementations. Compile the nested external consumer, test offset/clipped/zero/resize bounds and measurement purity. No app migration or false-parity claim.
bounded_sequence.reason: The approved Tree leaf is already available; a second tree implementation or more screen-specific renderer is unnecessary.

bounded_sequence.atomic_increment: Semantic row contract in Navigation, driven by frozen row measurements. Test metadata visibility at43/44/45, depth/label cell-width budget, trailing mark, custom content slots, disabled/hover/selected/focus/press, first-click choose/second-click activate and disclosure width2. Preserve default Tree behavior and public API. Demonstrate different inventory data.

Complete general detail/summary/action content composition using existing Panel, PropsRow.wrap, shared text/status sections, measured Group::wrap buttons and MasterDetail. Add only missing borrowed component adapters and layout/focus policies. Support width100 collapse and nested roster split at150 through shared responsive policy, not app Rect arithmetic. Prove bottom actions never overlap content and empty/overflow safe.
needs_explicit_proof: Props row wrapping/scroll and section heading behavior match frozen details, including instances, mounts, accounts, policy and clock.ago values.
Detail and narrow summary are real visible shared focusable content; selected pane/actions route baseline Tab/BackTab/Esc/Left/Right consistently.
Responsive nested roster is composable through shared APIs without application viewport if branches choosing alternate implementation.
Shell header/footer widgets have public composition adapters; Brand/MenuBar/status/hints use existing component paint and scope.

bounded_sequence.atomic_increment: Single actual Manager adoption/removal change after shared capabilities pass. Replace old list/update/private navigation, expansion, drawer and selection ownership; compose all Manager modes from the same AppShell/MasterDetail/Tree/Panel/Props/Button implementation; remove paint_pinned_split, ManagerSplit and SplitMode/SplitMount/SplitWorkspace/SplitInstance/SplitAlert family, all Manager-only historical callers/selector branches, and fake cursor/control patches together. Preserve legitimate domain actions/data.
must_include: Changed workspace names/order and empty/large hierarchy; no payments-platform lookup/fallback.
Current directory first, expanded workspace instances and new-workspace semantic rows in frozen order.
Repeated drawer/help/menu/launch open-close using actual same underlay, no scenario/paused-clock/exact-color/120x40 render path.
Continuous resize across99/100/101 and149/150/151 with shared draw/hit/focus bounds, seam capture/reset and focus restoration.

bounded_sequence.atomic_increment: Independent review plus real pinned tuiscotti frozen capture/replay/candidate checks at ordered nonzero input/resize/time checkpoints, including meaningful intermediate hover/press/scroll/focus states and deliberate visual/action defects. No image-only acceptance. Run all required workspace/hosted CI and twice-complete four-app gates separately.

first_safe_atomic_change: Add and compile the missing borrowed composition/block interop in existing Termrock facade, with a genuine external shell/master-detail/tree consumer and no Jackin production edits. If another active writer already owns this bridge, use that implementation rather than duplicate it.
limits: Tree adapter clearance proves a reusable leaf, not actual Manager use.
No whole-screen Manager block, simulation model in Termrock, copied renderer, correction painter, application-specific flag or exact test-size selector is acceptable.
Current incoming1e source, including unrelated editor rendering, is not independently approved by this plan.
All four application product and library acceptance gates remain incomplete.
